detail.longDescription: PH4NTXM: SHOWCASE 03 Explore the PH4NTXM OPSEC Suite, a collection of built-in tools for operational security. A showcase of the suite's graphical interfaces, monitoring capabilities, and security inspection utilities within the PH4NTXM environment. Featuring Network Inspection, Kernel Hardening, Suspicious Process Detection, Radio Security, ConnWatch, and Secure File Shredding. This video focuses on the visual presentation of the OPSEC Suite. Their functionality and underlying security mechanisms will be explored in upcoming videos. https://www. youtube.com/watch?v=tR3p4e8azX0 # ph4ntxm # linux # debian # os # live # privacy # security # opsec # infosec # research # tech # technology
